int_name: W ALLEGHENY AVE & N BROAD ST

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals, but the wide roadway and multiple travel lanes create a long exposure time for pedestrians. Active construction on the right side of the image introduces temporary obstacles and potential confusion for all road users.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Construction Zone
hazards.description: Traffic cones and barrels on the right side of the image may obstruct pedestrian paths or create unpredictable vehicle movements.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features wide roadways with multiple travel lanes and high-visibility crosswalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of median refuge increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or refuge island for pedestrians who may not be able to cross the entire width in one signal cycle.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area in the middle of the wide crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial with four travel lanes and on-street parking, featuring basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks and signals. However, the long crossing distance without a median refuge and the potential for high-speed traffic on a wide roadway present significant risks to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic plus parking lanes without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and wide sidewalks, providing a basic level of safety. However, the lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or a median refuge leaves pedestrians exposed across the entire roadway width.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the street without a mid-block refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions may allow vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
